caption:
Hashtags do not increase your reach. That is not a hot take — Mosseri said it out loud, and Instagram capped hashtags at five per post in December 2025.

So what are the 30 hashtags in your caption doing? Telling Instagram what your post is about, and helping it show up in search. That is it. That is the whole job.

Which means every hour you have ever spent building hashtag sets, rotating them, hiding them in the first comment, or buying a hashtag research tool bought you exactly nothing in distribution.

What actually moves reach: whether someone watches it, likes it, and sends it to a friend.

Pick five that describe the post honestly. Spend the rest of that time on the first three seconds.
